about: A small hotel's 水单 (folio) photo from the multi-screenshot QA set: no 结账单 title, 退房日期 for 离店日期, 收费 for 消费合计, and two fields to a line (入住日期:…日,房号:…). Every label variant reached no layout, so the folio was unrecognised. Captured from the real photo; guest, operator, company name and tax id redacted.
